skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1' row C default 'Ask again for the tagging' has no meaning on the upload path, where costs arrive per contract; the card should say tagging is not applicable when costs are supplied by contract.

references/method.md 'Step 1 — Confirm over-time recognition criteria' and 'Step 2' are [manual] with 'Confirm per contract' but the Stage 1 intake table never asks for them and gives no default. A strict agent either stops or silently assumes over-time; the card should add an intake row or a stated default ('assume over-time, single obligation, and flag').

references/method.md 'Step 7' gives the provision formula but not its presentation against the contract balance in 'Step 8' (US practice often presents the loss provision within billings in excess / as a separate liability). The skill is silent on whether C-12's 5,000 provision sits with or apart from its 15,000 contract liability.

references/method.md 'Step 11' and the Stage 5 instruction to present 'entries as proposals' assume the agent knows what is already booked. On an upload with no ledger balances, entries can only be cumulative targets; the skill does not say so.

SKILL.md upload checklist lists four separate Required uploads (contract list, estimates, costs and billings) each as XLSX; one combined CSV covered three of them. Validation wording ('Accepts every file ... noting any that only partly covers') is in the answer key but not in the skill text.
Coverage sheet ('Sheet 9') columns demand display_name, tool used and policy per contract; no manual-run variant.

SKILL.md 'Stage 1' row D: 'Blocking for that contract' — the protocol in mosofin-protocol.md says 'If a required input is rejected or missing, stop and ask ... do not carry on with the files that passed as though the set were complete.' The card's per-contract blocking and the protocol's whole-run stop conflict; the card should state that the other contracts proceed with the gap labelled.
sample_defects: No prior-period cumulative figures or earlier estimates, so 'Step 6 — catch-up' (one of the skill's core mechanics) cannot be tested.

Key finding 2 says 'loss 30,000 provided in full' without the split: (480,000 − 450,000) − (400,000 − 375,000) = 5,000 additional provision; 25,000 is already in cost over revenue. A run that booked a further 30,000 provision (double-counting) would match the key's wording.

Key omits the C-12 contract liability: revenue 450,000 x 400,000/480,000 = 375,000 vs billed 390,000 = 15,000 liability. The key only tests C-11's asset side, so the 'do not net across contracts' rule is untested.

The company is 'Northbrook Trading Ltd' (a trading company in the other samples) running construction contracts; file carries no company name, currency, scope, term, estimate owner or variation status.
C-11 % complete: 310,000/720,000 = 43.06%, which the key rounds to 43.1% — fine; revenue 900,000 x 0.430556 = 387,500 confirmed.
summary: PASS 3/3: rota rejected; C-11 43.1%/387,500, C-12 loss 30,000 (5,000 further provision), C-13 not computed. Key omits C-12 liability and the provision split.
